transports.name: envoy-chatgpt-user-compatible-2026
transports.provenance: Runnable reconstruction of the Envoy-compatible outbound transport independently observed with ChatGPT-User in 2026. Stock wreq 0.16.1/BoringSSL was measured on 2026-10-16 to reproduce the current-spec padded JA4, the saved ChatGPT-User JA3/raw TLS feature set, and the HTTP/2 preface exactly. Direct Envoy 1.39.1 is a reproduction control, not a production-version attribution. Transport compatibility does not authenticate OpenAI and may be shared by other application identities such as OAI-SearchBot.

observations.provenance: Current JA4 algorithm applied to the padded full ClientHello; independently reproduced by Envoy 1.39.1 and stock wreq 0.16.1. The older saved peet snapshot reported 78e6aca7449b while its JA4 extension count and JA3 prove padding 0015 was present on wire.
Current-spec raw JA4 for the reproduced full handshake, including TLS padding extension 0015.
Exact hash from the saved ChatGPT-User snapshot and both direct Envoy and wreq reproduction controls.
Exact normalized HTTP/2 preface. The older peet rendering omitted the textual setting id before :0; structured capture identifies it as SETTINGS_ENABLE_CONNECT_PROTOCOL (id 8).
